title: Removal of a Flap Track Carriage Roller Assembly
abstract: Removal of one flap track carriage roller assembly with the flaps at the maintenance position, including the load relief that must be applied before the roller is freed from the track.

sections.purpose: This task gives the procedure to remove one roller assembly from a flap track carriage, for bearing replacement or for inspection of the raceway.
sections.job_setup_note: Drive the flaps to the maintenance position and make the flap system safe before you get access to the carriage. The carriage must be supported and the load taken off the roller with the relief jack before the retaining nut is released; a roller that is still loaded will bind on the pin and can spring clear when it releases. Do one carriage at a time and do not disturb the adjacent carriage.
sections.procedure: 1. Drive the flaps to the maintenance position. 2. Make the flap system safe and install the warning notices at the flap control panel. WARNING: DO NOT DO THIS TASK WITH THE FLAP SYSTEM ENERGISED. THE FLAP CAN MOVE AND CRUSH A LIMB AGAINST THE TRACK. 3. Get access to the carriage in zone 562 or zone 662 as applicable. 4. Clean the carriage and the track locally. 5. Install the relief jack under the carriage and take the load off the roller. CAUTION: DO NOT LIFT THE CARRIAGE CLEAR OF THE TRACK. THE TRACK END STOP CAN BE DAMAGED IF THE CARRIAGE IS RAISED TOO FAR. 6. Release the lockwire and remove the retaining nut from the roller pin. 7. Withdraw the roller pin and collect the shims in the order they come off. 8. Take the roller assembly clear of the track. 9. Remove the drain filter D2750139843846 from the track drain path and keep it for inspection. 10. Do a detailed visual inspection of the raceway and of the track surface, and record any spalling before you continue.
sections.close_out: Identify the roller assembly and the shim stack by position. Leave the relief jack in place if the carriage is not to be reassembled in the same shift. Report any raceway spalling or track surface damage before the replacement roller is fitted. Make sure that the flap system stays isolated and that the warning notices are in position.

type_data.effectivity_note: All aircraft. Post MOD-162744 aircraft carry the double-lip seal; the seal comes away with the roller assembly and is not reusable.

safety_precautions: Make the flap system safe and put the warning notices in position.
Support the carriage with the relief jack before you release the roller pin.
Do not work under an unsupported carriage.
